section: National Bank of Canada: Microsoft Teams Rooms standard, gathering-space AV and delivery through construction delays
body:
This part of the National Bank of Canada case study covers what AVI-SPL Canada designed and delivered at National Bank Place in Montreal: a standard meeting room built on Microsoft Teams Rooms, custom AV for the gathering spaces, and how the deployment coped with construction delays.

**Standard meeting rooms**
- Employees had become familiar with Microsoft Teams while working remotely. To give them a smooth move into the new building and consistent, easy hybrid meetings, the bank made Microsoft Teams Rooms its primary design for meeting spaces.
- AVI-SPL Canada's proposal was a custom AV solution built around Microsoft Teams Rooms, with HP Poly cameras, Samsung displays and soundbars. One passage names the soundbars as Nureva.
- The HP Poly cameras adjust automatically to presenters in real time. The soundbars and displays are there so in-office and remote teams can communicate clearly.
- The case study describes the result as a consistent hybrid meeting experience that is flexible enough to evolve as new technologies emerge.
- Standardizing hybrid meetings also supported collaboration with the bank's other offices in Canada and abroad.
- Manuel Vallée Léger of National Bank said the bank achieved a high adoption rate and that the meeting room environment met users' expectations.

**Gathering spaces**
- The lobby, auditoriums, cafeteria and health and wellness center use video walls, wayfinding displays, projectors, speakers and microphones to show art and content.
- AVI-SPL Canada specialists worked with the bank's experience leaders to design the AV for these spaces. Together they selected Q-SYS core processors, Sennheiser microphones, Bose speakers, Epson projectors and Draper projection screens.
- Maxime Migneault, AV Solutions Integrator at National Bank, said AVI-SPL's expertise helped the bank choose the right products for non-standard rooms with atypical design, against its core objectives of simplicity, intuitiveness and customer experience.

**Delivery**
- Migneault said the early meetings produced a plan and clear roles for each stakeholder, which let the conference room deployment be integrated with the general contractor and other stakeholders.
- Supply chain issues and labor shortages caused construction delays and last-minute adjustments. AVI-SPL technicians adapted to each delay and implemented with minimal corrections.
- Migneault credited quality control during planning and execution, and the project manager's knowledge, for letting the bank deploy rooms as needed with high confidence that the technology would be in place.

**When to use this**
Use it for questions about standardizing on Microsoft Teams Rooms across a large building, AV for lobbies and auditoriums, or how AVI-SPL handles a deployment tied to a construction schedule.

**Not stated in this source**: device model numbers, the adoption rate as a figure, or dates for the deployment.
